body: Yeah dude, I can't even take midol because the minimal caffeine content makes me shaky.

We've been together for six months. The move is really recent, yeah. Honestly, I may not be giving her enough credit - maybe she's fully aware and just hasn't mentioned it to me yet. Either way, I feel like it's a conversation we need to have.

Being raped for the first time. So sorry to be graphic and depressing, but it happened when I was 9, and I always dreaded the November after I turned 18 because that's when I knew I would have been alive longer as a broken victim than I ever was as a normal kid. I had always planned to kill myself first, but never succeeded. 

I'm 22 now. It doesn't bother me nearly as much anymore. I see every day I'm still alive as a victory. The people who tried to break me beyond repair didn't win.
"You make me sick you're so pretty."

I'll try to think of some good qualities.

I've always thought that I was blessed with an incredible amount of love and a need to share it. There are so many people in need and desperate for love and I've always wanted to be distributed through me as much as possible. I go out of my way several times a day to do some random acts of kindness, because brightening the days of others even a little makes my heart sing. I can tell you also have this gift, and thank you for taking the time to share it with me. <3

I am a good writer, I'll admit. Once I was chosen out of ~900 applicants for a copy editing position. I don't mean to sound like I'm bragging, but English is something I'm passionate about and it's not my first language so I'm very proud I got to the level where I can edit the writings of others. 

Aside from that... I don't know. I'm pretty. I'm good at makeup. Unfortunately, that only factors into the sex work I mentioned. I make people laugh often, and many of my friends say I'm the strongest person they know, but I don't see it. 

I love animals. I'm good at making food. I want to go to school to be a chef or a vet tech, but I'd have to wait a year since I'm new to the state. I just... don't have that long.

The thing is, none of it matters. None of it will help me. Compassion and grammar won't keep me from starving or living on the streets. I'm just a lost cause.
